source: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB), National Air Quality Index, Control of Urban Pollution Series CUPS/82/2014-15 (October 2014)
note: Sub-index is linear interpolation within the breakpoint band; overall AQI = maximum sub-index, valid when at least three pollutants (including PM2.5 or PM10) are available. The upper limits of the 'Severe' band (401-500) are not specified as concentration caps in a uniform way; the values marked as extrapolation caps are modelling assumptions and AQI is capped at 500.

categories.name: Severe
categories.health: Respiratory effects even on healthy people

extrapolationCaps: Upper concentration of the Severe band for each pollutant (PM10 510, PM2.5 380, NO2 800, O3 1000, CO 50, SO2 2400) is a modelling assumption used only for interpolation.
